answer: Each agent joins the network by staking a “willow token” that vouches its identity; the token is linked to a unique proof‑of‑resource derived from an orchard‑seed hash, and the stake is recorded on a tundra‑wide Merkle tree of trust. When a new agent is vouched, existing voters must each lock an additional 0.5 % of their stake for a 48‑hour challenge window; if any vouchee later misbehaves, all voters’ locked tokens are slashed, instantly reducing their standing.
